A one-week, two-class cut is where people get hurt, and I won't write that plan. Dropping that much that fast means dehydration and extreme restriction, and the amounts involved are a call for a doctor or a sports dietitian who can see you in person, not a coach in a chat. I also can't promise how any week turns out.

What I can do is the training side. I can build your sessions this week around keeping strength and staying fresh for the weigh-in and the event. Tell me the sport, the date, and what you're running now, and I'll set that up.
